scope: Large 5 x 5.5 in water-cooled stationary radial of Langley Aerodrome A (built 1901): engine proper, flywheels and shaft stubs. Teaching reconstruction from the 1911 Memoir drawings; not a manufacturing drawing, not an authenticated running model.

P78.text: Memoir Plate 78 page renders, per-half calibration in plates.json

link_rod_hole.rationale: Link rods have a 5/8 in hole (M1 p. 240, page image).

gudgeon_pin_diameter.rationale: Hollow case-hardened gudgeon pins 7/8 in (M1 p. 240, page image).

rod_length.rationale: Gudgeon-pin to crank-pin axis. Not documented. Bounds: shoe clearance (about 278 mm for 55 degree shoes) and the 37 in overall diameter taken over the cylinder jackets: 2 x (r + L + 112.9 mm above the pin) = 37 in. The fold-out of Plate 78 hides the strip that would measure it.
rod_length.method: Overall diameter 37 in (A1 p. 156) minus the jacket top above the pin (Plate 78A) minus the crank radius.

jacket_outer_radius.method: Plate 78A, right wall x = 2185 px, cylinder axis x = 1739 px, 149.6 px/in.

shell_outer_radius.rationale: Bore radius plus the two documented walls.

cylinder_flange_height.rationale: Open end of the cylinder barrel above the shaft axis. Plate 78B shows the section walls ending at 104 mm, but two neighbouring 133 mm shells (axes 72 degrees apart) only clear each other from 1.176 x height >= 133.4, i.e. 113.4 mm, and a flange wider than the shell needs about 140 mm of centre distance at its height; the plate section does not show the neighbours. 132 mm gives a flange 140 mm wide across the cylinder plane with 15 mm to spare.
cylinder_flange_height.method: Measured 104 mm on Plate 78B (row 50 px, axis row 648 px, 145.7 px/in); raised so that neighbouring shells and flanges do not overlap.

dome_height.rationale: Dome apex above the barrel top.

valve_axis_x.rationale: Offset of the inlet and exhaust valve axis from the cylinder axis, toward the port drum.
valve_axis_x.method: Plate 78A, stem at x = 1075 px, cylinder axis 1739 px, 149.6 px/in.

cam_rise.rationale: Rise of a cam lobe: valve lift 12.0 mm plus the documented 1/64 in (0.397 mm) gap. Lift and lobe form are not documented and are illustrative.

cam_lobe_half_width.rationale: Half width of a cam lobe in cam degrees (illustrative): 28 degrees of cam is 112 degrees of crank, so each exhaust valve is open for 224 degrees.

cam_lobe_phase.rationale: Direction of a cam lobe centre at the rest pose, from the exhaust timing: peak lift 270 degrees after power top dead centre (illustrative), cylinder 1 at the top of its exhaust stroke at theta = 0, cam at -1/4 crank speed.

sleeve_half_length.rationale: Master sleeve with its nuts spans X = +/-66 mm between the crank webs.

web_inner_x.rationale: Inner faces of the two crank webs at X = +/-70 mm.

shaft_outer_diameter.rationale: Hollow shaft outside diameter about 2.0 in on Plate 78B.
shaft_outer_diameter.method: Plate 78B bands at rows 455-503 and 690-750, 145.7 px/in; rounded.

shaft_bore.rationale: Shaft bore between 27 and 36 mm on the two sides of Plate 78B; the upper end is used because the crank shaft is 5,225 g in the weight table (M1 p. 250), which a 1.25 in bore overshoots.

crank_pin_diameter.rationale: Crank pin outside diameter from its wall bands on Plate 78B.
crank_pin_diameter.method: Plate 78B: pin wall bands rows 70-97 and 212-240 around bore 31 mm, 145.7 px/in.

shaft_port_end_x.rationale: Port end of the hollow shaft (coupling flange face) on Plate 78B.
shaft_port_end_x.method: Plate 78B x = 190 px, X0 at 1714 px, 145.7 px/in.

shaft_starboard_end_x.rationale: Starboard end of the shaft; the plate is cut at the page edge, so symmetry with the port flange offset is assumed.

crank_web_thickness.rationale: Crank web thickness; the outer faces stand 2 mm inside the drum head plates at |X| = 96.

sleeve_outer_radius.rationale: Steel sleeve outer radius from the stacked bands on Plate 78B (pin 47 mm, lining 3 mm, sleeve about 8.5 mm).

shoe_angular_width.rationale: Shoes are "slightly less than sixty degrees" wide (M1 p. 237); at the proportions r/L = 0.24 two adjacent rods can approach to 55.6 degrees, so the model uses 50 degrees (research dossier, closure check).

piston_clearance_diametral.rationale: Piston .005 in under the bore at the middle (M1 p. 239).

flange_thickness.rationale: Mounting flange thickness; the cylinder mass in the weight table (4.6-4.8 kg with valves) rules out a thick flange.

drum_head_thickness.rationale: Head plate thickness; the starboard drum is 3,440 g in the weight table (M1 p. 250), which fixes a thin sheet.

cam_train_module.rationale: Module of the cam gear train; layout and tooth counts are illustrative and chosen to give net -1/4 exactly with three external meshes and no two gears of one plane overlapping.

cam_gear_ratio.rationale: Cam turns at one quarter crank speed in the reverse direction (M1 p. 237).

punch_rod_gap.rationale: Punch rods stand within 1/64 in of the exhaust stems (M1 p. 237).

ignition_gear_ratios.rationale: Primary sparker cam at 2.5x and distributor at 0.5x crank speed (M1 p. 241); gears 30/60/12 teeth give exactly 0.5 and 2.5.

inlet_manifold_wall.rationale: Wall of the inlet manifold tube. Not drawn; the weight table (1,700 g) with the measured ring (78.4 mm tube, radius 493.65 mm) gives about 0.24 mm once the flanges are counted.
inlet_manifold_wall.method: 1,700 g over steel density, ring length 3,101 mm and tube circumference 246 mm, branches and flanges included.

water_pipe_wall.rationale: Wall of the water ring pipes; the weight table (outlet 450 g, inlet 360 g) gives 0.28-0.32 mm.
water_pipe_wall.method: 450 g and 360 g against the measured ring radii and tube diameters.

transmission_shaft_diameter.rationale: Transmission shafts 1.5 in outside diameter (M1 p. 242).

balance_arm_thickness.rationale: Balance arm plate thickness; the arms with their braces weigh 1,040 g and 1,067 g in the weight table (M1 p. 250).

flywheel_outer_radius.rationale: Rims 33 in in diameter (M1 p. 243, steel automobile-wheel rims); the aluminium rims are assumed to match.

flywheel_rim_thickness_port.rationale: U-section rim thickness, set so that the port flywheel weighs 3,234 g (M1 p. 250).

flywheel_rim_thickness_stbd.rationale: U-section rim thickness, set so that the stbd flywheel weighs 3,946 g (M1 p. 250).
